verdict.rationale: Cactus's own docs list 'a coding agent with your API key' as a supported way to run the platform. It backs this with an agent-oriented llms.txt (probe-confirmed live), a /v1/openapi.json spec, and REST endpoints for generating data, fine-tuning, uploading, and checking billing. An agent can therefore drive the product as a real backend. The probe 404s were only on root-level OpenAPI paths and do not contradict the /v1 spec. Missing for 10: a dedicated agent setup guide or MCP/agent integration docs, and independent hands-on reports of a coding agent actually using the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend
